$comment: MIS PORTAL CONFIG v3 - Notepad me edit kar sakte ho. NAYI COMPANY add karni ho to companies list me ek line jodo (jaise {"code":"XYZ","name":"XYZ Pvt Ltd"}) aur TB/workbook paths me uska block - bas.

salesWorkbook.$comment: IWSR/CN/Purchase wali workbook - month ke hisab se update karke isi path par rakho (purana replace hota rahega)

salesWorkbooks.$comment: PURANE SAAL ke sales registers (IWSR/CN same format). Ye files yahan banao: F:/Financial Report/workbooks/ me. Har file me SAKAR+SVN dono ki IWSR/CN sheets ho sakti hain (sheet-names alag ho to iwsr/creditNote me override karo). Jab tak file nahi hai, loader warning dega aur skip karega.

salesCsvFiles.$comment: SAP B1 query-export CSVs (UTF-16) - E: drive se copy karke yahan rakho. entity = kis company ka data hai. SIRF PURANE SAAL register karo (current-FY CSV workbook ke IWSR sheet ka duplicate hota hai - dono load karne par double-count). Sales-FY-2026-27-Apr-Aug.csv backup me csv folder me pada hai.

tbWorkbooks.$comment: HAR FINANCIAL YEAR KA TB - naya FY shuru ho to naya {} block jodo. Current-year file time-to-time replace hogi.

tbLayout.$comment: TB sheet ka layout - SAKAR aur SVN ka thoda alag hai

stockUploads.$comment: Har mahine stock file yahan daalo: F:/Financial Report/uploads/stock/ me. Columns (A se M): Company, FY, Month, Item No, Item Desc, Item Group, Opening Qty, Produced Qty, Sold Qty, Closing Qty, Closing Value, Last Sale Month, Last Sale Date. Template: templates/STOCK-UPLOAD-TEMPLATE.xlsx

loanUploads.$comment: Loan details (optional): F:/Financial Report/uploads/loans/ me repayment-schedule format (template dekho). SAKAR ke liye ye use karo. SVN auto aa jata hai Loan-SVN sheet se (neeche loanSheets).

loanSheets.$comment: Workbook ke andar jo loan-schedule sheets hain unhe direct parse karo - entity -> sheet-name. Column-blocks: D/H/L/P/T = Total/Principle/Interest triplets, R2 me loan-names, A=FY code (jaise 26-27), B=month. NOTE: Loan-SVN sheet me SAKAR ke loans hain (user-confirmed)

svnLoanRps.$comment: SVN Term Loan RPS Working file - Term Loan + Car Loan sheets (D/E/F triplets, R2=loan-name, A=FY, B=month-date) + Loan Summery (master-only loans: 802920431/ECGS/DBS x2)
svnLoanRps.file: E:/Account Master/A-Sakar/11. Archieve/Loans/SVN Term Loan RPS Working till closure - Revised.xlsx

creditNoteCsv.$comment: Credit-Note register CSV (SAP UTF-16) - HISTORY ke liye. uptoMonth = is month se pehle tak ka data CSV se (workbook CN sheets current-FY dete hain - overlap double-count guard isliye zaroori). Jab workbook CN me purane saal bhi aa jayen to isko hata dena.

fgPurchaseCsv.$comment: FG Purchase ledger CSV (510101008, SAP UTF-16) - channel-2 rejection ke liye. PC(A/P Credit Memo)=customer-rejection return, PD(GRPO)=normal inward purchase (rejection me NAHI ginta), OB/JE/PU/BC=skip. Vendor-code Offset-Account column me hai (V####) - CUSTOMER-MASTER template me vendor-code daalke link karna hai, phir customer-name auto aa jayega. uptoMonth = workbook FG-Purchase sheet overlap-guard.

tbHistoryCsv.$comment: PURANE FY ka TB (SAP 42-col export CSV, UTF-16) - SAKAR history. Ledger rows (9-digit code) store hoti hain, group-rows hierarchy ke liye. mappingSource=tb-column, history=true - Ledger Mapping me map karne par PL/BS history bhi banegi.

stmtPLFiles.$comment: NEW PL STATEMENT (user ki official monthly PL) - app ke Sales/Revenue figures ISSE aane chahiye, register se nahi. File = har FY ka summary workbook, sheet = 'New PL'. Structure: col1 = row-label; SAKAR block cols 2-13 (Apr..Mar monthly, col1 me label pehle), SVN block cols 17-28. Row-label 'Total of Sales'/'Operational Revenue' = monthly operational revenue (GST-exclusive sales + jobwork etc). currentFyMonths = current FY me kitne months bharre hain (Apr=5 columns filled).

ai.$comment: TB-Review ke AI-explanations ke liye. apiKey dalo (Google AI Studio se free milti hai: aistudio.google.com -> Get API key) to Gemini chalega; key khali rahegi to built-in CA-rules se offline explanation milega. model: gemini-2.0-flash (fast) ya gemini-2.5-pro (deep).

deadStockRules.$comment: Dead/Non-moving stock ki definition - months sale nahi hua to
